2608.25981.title: FRAME: separating sampling variation from representational cause in medical imaging fairness
2608.25981.paper_summary: Subgroup performance differences are the standard evidence for fairness bias in medical imaging, and the usual response removes the demographic information that a model encodes. Here we introduce Fair-model Reference And Mechanism Evaluation (FRAME), a two-step framework for auditing such a claim. The first step derives a fair-model reference, the distribution of the difference under exact fairness at the observed subgroup sizes. In the second step, we test the remainder with two operators in representation space. One operator cannot change a within-group ranking by construction. Across 702,206 images and 36 encoders, the reference accounts for a median 41% of the reported race difference and 22% of the age difference. Injecting demographic decodability leaves the remainder unchanged, while entangling the group with the disease direction raises the race difference from 0.077 to 0.118. No intervention we tested changes the remainder more than a change of random seed does. Those interventions reduce a difference at the operating point and leave the within-group ranking difference at a median of 0.000. Applied to 89 differences in 9 published studies across 6 medical imaging modalities, the reference accounts for a median 25% of a rate difference and 70% of a difference in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. Image-text pretraining instead raises worst-group performance by about 0.05. Applying FRAME before choosing an intervention could distinguish differences that need a mechanistic explanation from differences compatible with sampling variation at the current cohort sizes.
2608.25981.paper_summary_zh: 子群體表現差異是醫學影像中公平偏見的標準證據，通常的回應是去除模型編碼的人口統計信息。在這裡，我們介紹公平模型參考與機制評估（FRAME），這是一個用於審核此類主張的兩步框架。第一步推導出公平模型參考，即在觀察到的子群體大小下，精確公平的差異分佈。在第二步中，我們使用表示空間中的兩個運算符來測試其餘部分。一個運算符在結構上無法改變群內排名。跨越702,206張影像和36個編碼器，該參考解釋了報告的種族差異的中位數41%和年齡差異的22%。注入人口統計可解碼性使其餘部分保持不變，而將群體與疾病方向糾纏則將種族差異從0.077提高到0.118。我們測試的任何干預都沒有比隨機種子變化更改其餘部分。這些干預在操作點上減少了差異，並將群內排名差異保持在中位數0.000。應用於6種醫學影像模式中9項已發表研究的89個差異，該參考解釋了率差異的中位數25%和接收者操作特徵曲線下的面積差異的70%。圖像-文本預訓練反而將最差群體的表現提高了約0.05。在選擇干預之前應用FRAME，可以區分需要機制解釋的差異與與當前隊列大小相容的抽樣變異的差異。
